match.src: comment: * Apache prior to Apache 2.2.8 has a bug in it * whereby it doesn't force '100 Continue' * response before responding with headers if no * read. So, force a zero length read before * sending the headers if haven't yet attempted * to read anything. This will ensure that if no * request content has been read that any '100 * Continue' response will be flushed and sent * back to the client if client was expecting * one. Only want to do this for 2xx and 3xx * status values. Note that even though Apple * supplied version of Apache on MacOS X Leopard * is newer than version 2.2.8, the header file * has never been patched when they make updates * and so anything compiled against it thinks it * is older. */ [747,1610]
